headline: Cabinet Committee on Security approves Rs 40,000 crore warship project
hook: Major boost for domestic naval manufacturing
summary: The Cabinet Committee on Security (CCS) has cleared a proposal worth Rs 40,000 crore for the acquisition of warships for the Indian Navy. This move is part of the government's push to enhance maritime defense capabilities and promote indigenous manufacturing. The project is expected to involve major domestic shipbuilders and defense contractors. Indian retail investors in the defense sector may see long-term benefits from increased order books for public and private shipyards.
whats_next: Formal contract signing and tender issuance by the Ministry of Defence
why_it_matters: Defense shipbuilders gain long-term revenue visibility from government contracts.
winners_losers: Domestic shipbuilders gain / No clear losers

headline: Six Nifty 500 stocks currently trading with RSI below 30
hook: Six Nifty 500 stocks hit oversold territory
summary: Six stocks within the Nifty 500 index, including Mazagon Dock and Avenue Supermarts, have reached an RSI level below 30. Retail investors often use this indicator to identify potential entry points or to assess the severity of a stock's downward trend.
why_it_matters: Oversold status may signal a potential price reversal or further weakness.

headline: Mazagon Dock shares crash 10% after Q2 net profit falls 54% to Rs 344 crore
summary: State-owned Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders reported a 54% year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 344 crore, alongside a 16.5% drop in revenue to Rs 2,446 crore. Operating margins contracted sharply during the quarter, triggering a 10% crash in the company's share price. Despite the earnings slump, the firm declared an interim dividend of Rs 5 per share. Indian retail investors holding defence sector stocks face near-term volatility following the weaker-than-expected financial performance.
why_it_matters: Defence portfolio returns face pressure from tumbling earnings.
